title: Did Lakshmana Never Sleep?

captions.instagram:
Part 2 of 2. In Valmiki's Ramayana, Lakshmana stays awake all night on the Tamasa, telling Sumantra of Rama's virtues. By the Ganga, Guha offers him a bed, and he answers: "How could I sleep while my brother lies on the bare ground with Sita?" Past the Ganga, Rama says: "From today, we two must keep watch." And by the Yamuna, Valmiki writes that Rama gently woke Lakshmana, who had been sleeping beside him. He kept watch, and he slept too. Both tellings are told with devotion.

Which night moved you most: the Tamasa, Guha's watch, or Rama waking Lakshmana? 👇 Jai Shri Ram!

📜 Source: Valmiki Ramayana, Ayodhya Kanda 2.41-50 (Critical Edition)

captions.youtube_title: Did Lakshmana Never Sleep for 14 Years? Valmiki Ramayana | Part 2 #Shorts
captions.youtube_description:
Part 2 of 2. In Valmiki's Ramayana, Lakshmana stays awake all night on the Tamasa, telling Sumantra of Rama's virtues. By the Ganga, Guha offers him a bed, and he answers: "How could I sleep while my brother lies on the bare ground with Sita?" Past the Ganga, Rama says: "From today, we two must keep watch." And by the Yamuna, Valmiki writes that Rama gently woke Lakshmana, who had been sleeping beside him. He kept watch, and he slept too. Both tellings are told with devotion.

Which night moved you most: the Tamasa, Guha's watch, or Rama waking Lakshmana? 👇 Jai Shri Ram!

Source: Valmiki Ramayana, Ayodhya Kanda 2.41-50 (Critical Edition)
Verses:
• First night, on the Tamasa: Rama and Sita slept; Lakshmana stayed awake all night with the charioteer Sumantra, speaking of Rama's virtues — 2.41.12-14
• At Shringaverapura Guha offers Lakshmana a bed and says his people will keep watch — 2.45.2-3
• Lakshmana: how can I sleep, or live, or enjoy, while Rama lies on the ground with Sita? — 2.45.9
• Past the Ganga, Rama: from today we two must stay awake at night; Sita's safety rests on us two — 2.47.3
• By the Yamuna (after Bharadvaja's ashram), at night's end Rama gently woke Lakshmana, who had been sleeping beside him; Lakshmana shook off sleep and the road's fatigue — 2.49.15; 2.50.1-3
• No Nidra Devi and no 14-year sleep of Urmila (or 14-year wakefulness of Lakshmana) in the CE — whole text searched (all 7 kandas)

verify_note: Whole CE searched (Bala 76, Ayodhya 111, Aranya 71, Kishkindha 66, Sundara 66, Yuddha 116, Uttara 100 sargas): ऊर्मिला only at 1.70.21-22, 1.71.3, 1.72.18, 1.76.9 and 2.110.51 (1.32.12 is another Urmila, a gandharvi's mother). No Nidra Devi, no 14-year sleep. Nights: 1 Tamasa 2.41.12-14 (Lakshmana awake all night with Sumantra); 2 Shringaverapura 2.44.25-26, 2.45.2-3 (Guha offers the bed), 2.45.9 (Lakshmana's reply); 3 under a tree past the Ganga 2.47.1-3 (Rama: we two must keep awake); 4 Bharadvaja 2.48-49.1; 5 by the Yamuna 2.49.15; morning 2.50.1-3 Rama gently wakes the sleeping Lakshmana.
